data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies across the Defense & Security sector: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and Anduril Industries.

The peer-median approach applied here uses four same-sector, same-stage private comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median valuation across this set is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This dispersion reflects meaningful variation in investor appetite and perceived runway within the frontier-defense robotics cohort at Series A. This single triangulation method implies a valuation of $700M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M median. This relatively narrow band reflects consistency within the peer-median method; however, the underlying peer range ($125M–$4.0B) signals material uncertainty around capital efficiency, technical differentiation, and customer concentration that cannot be resolved through multiples alone. Key unknowns include Greenroom's revenue traction, capital efficiency relative to peers, customer diversification, and defensibility of intellectual property within an increasingly crowded defense-robotics landscape.
